title: JuniorFriendlyGitHubIssueTemplate
description: Template schema for generating structured, clear, and actionable GitHub Issues.

title.description: Conventional commit style issue title (e.g. feat(auth): add refresh token endpoint).

body.description: Markdown body containing Overview, Technical Context, and Acceptance Criteria checklist.

default.title: feat(<scope>): <short description>
default.body:
## Overview
Brief description of what feature is being built or what bug is being resolved.

## Technical Context
Architectural considerations, relevant files, and services involved.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Core business logic implemented adhering to Clean Code standards
- [ ] Colocated unit test suite achieves >= 80% coverage
- [ ] TypeScript compilation passes cleanly without any explicit any types
